items.message: _state reads the sha from ls-remote then fetches by ref, but uses the pre-fetch sha for cat-file — a concurrent push between ls-remote and fetch could make the sha stale.
_swap writes the `new` blob unconditionally with hash-object -w before knowing whether the push will succeed, leaving orphaned loose objects on failed swaps.
LedgerScope is re-exported from core.ports here but the public import surface for callers of this module is not shown to be tested — minor omission in the description.
